notes: Standard Shopify Dawn theme. Stock is INVERTED but the badge selector is not stock-specific: '.card__badge .badge' can also render 'Nyhet' (new) or sale badges, not just 'Slutsåld' (sold out) — scraper must check the badge's text content equals 'Slutsåld' to mark out-of-stock, not just presence. Price text contains both price__regular and price__sale blocks; when not discounted both show the same value — take the price-item--sale value if present and non-empty, else price-item--regular. 17 in-stock + 5 sold-out products, 2 pages confirmed. Ticket 17: '/collections/forkop' is the preorder collection, 8 products at audit time, all Pokémon and each named '(Förköp) …', though the collection is shop-wide. 2026-09-02: the shop prints Shopify's English money format, '5,499 kr' for 5499 kr, not the '5 499 kr' of the original audit. The comma read as a decimal separator, so every price over 999 kr landed 1000x too low (5.499) and the SEK branch of the suspicious-price guard let it through. parse_price now treats a comma followed by exactly three digits as a thousands group. 76 stored prices were wrong; they were multiplied back by 1000 in place so the fix would not fire a price_rise for every product. max_pages went 3 -> 5 the same day: /collections/pokemon-booster-packs runs to 4 pages (51 products), so the cap was cutting off a page and the run said so.
